$comment: Kiorex Passport IdP configuration-as-code (KX-04 KA-01..KA-05, KX-22). Single source of truth read by (a) apps/dev-idp (environment 'local') and (b) the Cognito OpenTofu stack (environments 'staging'/'production'). Never put production secrets here: the tofu stack generates client secrets into Secrets Manager. No clinical data in tokens or claims (ADR-013).

scopes.name: email
scopes.description: The person's own e-mail, only after they verified it with a code (email_verified is an explicit true only then). Optional; Kiorex uses it for corporate-benefit domain eligibility.

scopes.name: kx
scopes.description: Role hints only. Never grants clinical access (ADR-013/BR40).

scopes.name: kx_org
scopes.description: Organisation membership hints (org_id + role hint). Never grants clinical access (ADR-013/BR40).

claimsMapping.$comment: IdP attribute -> token claim. Cognito: custom attributes are declared on the user pool schema (custom:kx_roles etc.) and mapped via the pre-token-generation trigger.

sub.note: Opaque ULID/UUID; never derived from phone or email (KX-04 §03).

kx_orgs.note: KA-09. Only when scope kx_org is requested. Hints only; the product decides permissions (KX-04 section 03).

act.note: KA-06. RFC 8693 actor claim on guardian acting-as tokens: sub = dependant, act.sub = guardian.

acr.note: KA-10. urn:kiorex:acr:basic (phone OTP / federation) or urn:kiorex:acr:mfa (second factor or user-verifying passkey).

amr.note: KA-10. RFC 8176 values (otp, swk, hwk, user, mfa) plus Kiorex extensions 'totp' and 'fed'.

$forbiddenClaimsNote: KA-13 / KX-04 Rev 2.3: patient addresses live in the Kiorex patient profile; professions, licences and verification evidence live in Kiorly (ADR-013, ADR-029). None may appear in any token, userinfo, event or org entry. Edition is a display hint held by Passport and shown by the product; the token carries org_id + role_hint only (KA-14).

tokenLifetimes.$comment: KA-04: access <= 15 min; refresh 30 days with rotation + reuse detection; audience-specific tokens.

mfaPolicy.$comment: KA-03/KA-10: TOTP for privileged/ops/provider roles. The dev IdP enforces TOTP locally (otplib) at login for accounts holding any requiredForRoles role (a user-verifying passkey also satisfies it). Production: Cognito MFA = ON with software token for these groups via pre-auth/step-up.
mfaPolicy.policyNote: 27 Nov 2026: MFA is OPTIONAL for everybody except the baseline requiredForRoles above (Passport ROLES, unchanged). An ops_admin proposes and a second ops_admin or super_admin approves (a super_admin may apply directly, audited) a policy in the Passport ops console (Ops, MFA policy) that makes TOTP or a user-verifying passkey MANDATORY at sign-in for chosen roles (membership role hints and Passport roles; * = every member) everywhere, per organisation type (clinic, nurse, pharmacy, lab) or per organisation. Default OFF. It can only add requirements. assignableRoles are extra role names a policy may name (product staff roles that Passport memberships may carry).

stepUp.$comment: KA-10. Products require acr=urn:kiorex:acr:mfa and a fresh auth_time for money, clinical and ops actions. The IdP issues a step-up token from POST /api/step-up after TOTP or a user-verifying passkey assertion.

guardianship.$comment: KA-06 (KX-04 sections 03/05). Guardian links expire automatically at the age of majority. TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN: legal confirmation of the age per market and of the accepted evidence types (Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md).

orgs.$comment: KA-09. Membership = hint only; products decide permissions. No clinical data in orgs, memberships or claims (ADR-013).
orgs.roleHintsNote: KX-04 Rev 2.3 KA09: owner, admin, finance, doctor, physiotherapist, nurse, dispatcher, assistant, front_desk. receptionist/pharmacist/lab_technician/staff are kept for existing memberships and Pharmacy/Lab. Strings only: profession, licence and scope of practice stay in Kiorly (ADR-029); a nursing agency owner/admin is owner/admin of an org whose edition is NURSE.
orgs.editionsNote: KA-14: edition (CLINIC|NURSE) is a DISPLAY HINT on the organisation (KX-04 section 03, ADR-031). One subject may hold memberships in orgs of different editions (solo nurse + agency). The token kx_orgs carries org_id + role_hint only; the product shows the edition.

federation.$comment: KA-11 dev: a second fake upstream IdP (apps/dev-idp/src/fake-upstream.ts). Production uses enterprise SAML/OIDC federation in the managed IdP (phase 4).

production.backchannelLogoutUri: TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN: Kiorex API URL (api.kiorex.com?) per KX-19

clients.name: Kiorex booking widget (embedded; Passport opens in a popup from the widget host)
clients.$comment: GRW-P1-G: public PKCE client of the embeddable booking widget. The widget app runs on the widget host (domains.json `widget`: book.kiorex.com; local = the Kiorex API port) inside the provider's iframe and opens Passport in a POPUP; the popup returns to /v1/embed/auth/callback on that host, which hands the one-time code to the iframe. No refresh token (the access token lives in widget memory only), no back-channel URI (the widget holds no server session).

clients.name: Kiorly (staff app, Expo; bundle com.kiorly.app)
clients.$comment: Public PKCE native client for the Kiorly staff app (final name, founder decision 23 Nov 2026; replaces the legacy client kiorly-team, which stays registered so installed dev builds keep working). Local redirects: native scheme kiorly, the Expo dev-client scheme exp+kiorly, and Expo web on :8082. No back-channel URI: the staff app holds no server session; products revoke through their own session APIs. Staging/production use the same native schemes (config only; the Cognito app client is created from this entry, store/bundle ids per Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md).

clients.name: Kiorly Team (LEGACY staff app client, superseded by kiorly)
clients.$comment: LEGACY (kept additive, 23 Nov 2026): the previous staff-app name Kiorly Team, now final-renamed Kiorly (client kiorly). Local redirects: native scheme kiorlyteam, the Expo dev-client scheme exp+kiorly-team, and Expo web on :8082. No back-channel URI: the staff app holds no server session; products revoke through their own session APIs. Staging/production use the same native schemes (config only; the Cognito app client is created from this entry, store/bundle ids per Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md).

clients.name: Kiorex Passport (self-service web)
clients.$comment: The Passport self-service SPA served at /account. First-party; calls the /api account endpoints with its own access token. The dev IdP rewrites the local redirect URIs to its own issuer origin so tests on other ports work.

clients.name: Kiorly Clinic + Kiorly Nurse (provider SSO, KCV-201 seam; ONE client, edition-aware, aud=kiorly-clinic for both editions, KX-04 Rev 2.3)
clients.$comment: Kiorly Nurse is an edition of Kiorly Clinic (ADR-031): same OIDC client, same audience. Local dev: the Nurse edition runs on the same Kiorly web, http://localhost:5174 (CLAUDE.md), so no extra local redirect URI is needed. The :5184 entries are the DEV FALLBACK for when another checkout owns :5174 (this workspace then runs its Clinic web on :5184 and its Clinic API on :3011). Production nurse.kiorly.com URIs are TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN (KX-19 domain confirmation).

clients.name: Kiorly Pharmacy staff web
clients.$comment: Staff web, OIDC authorization code + PKCE (S256), public client. The browser only redirects; the product API redeems the code server-side (POST /api/v1/auth/oidc/exchange) because the IdP token endpoint is not CORS-enabled, and returns the RP-initiated logout URL (id_token_hint) the web navigates to on sign-out; the registered post-logout URI is the web root. Back-channel logout: Passport POSTs a signed logout_token to <product API>/api/v1/auth/oidc/backchannel-logout when a session is revoked (account page, admin, sign-out elsewhere) or the account is deleted; the API ends the matching web session (sid) at once. The web session also has a short max age (OIDC_SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, default 1 h) as a fallback. Staging/production registration is config only (Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md).

clients.name: Kiorly Lab staff web
clients.$comment: Staff web, OIDC authorization code + PKCE (S256), public client. The browser only redirects; the product API redeems the code server-side (POST /api/v1/auth/oidc/exchange) because the IdP token endpoint is not CORS-enabled, and returns the RP-initiated logout URL (id_token_hint) the web navigates to on sign-out; the registered post-logout URI is the web root. Back-channel logout: Passport POSTs a signed logout_token to <product API>/api/v1/auth/oidc/backchannel-logout when a session is revoked (account page, admin, sign-out elsewhere) or the account is deleted; the API ends the matching web session (sid) at once. The web session also has a short max age (OIDC_SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, default 1 h) as a fallback. Staging/production registration is config only (Docs/NEEDS_HUMAN.md).

clients.name: Kiorly Home (one web sign-in for Kiorly Clinic, Nurse, Pharmacy and Lab)
clients.$comment: ADR-038. Public SPA client (code + PKCE S256) at kiorly.com/signin (alias app.kiorly.com): signs the person in to Passport, calls GET /api/workspaces with its own access token, then redirects to the chosen product, which completes its OWN silent code flow against the Passport session. Never used by the products. Local dev port 5194, route /signin. Production URIs are TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN (domain/DNS and the production Passport client).

workspaces.$comment: ADR-038 / GET /api/workspaces. Product URLs are NOT here: they come from config/domains.json per environment (override KX_WORKSPACE_URL_<PRODUCT|NURSE>). Nurse is an EDITION of Clinic (ADR-031): same app, edition NURSE, host nurse.<domain>. Source today: Passport organisation memberships (product from product_refs, default clinic); the Passport-to-staff links in the product APIs become the authoritative source (seam documented in KX-08).
